pakistan-2024.notes: The report gives the main contest as 2 February 2025 (1 February was a mock round), not the catalogue's 2025-02-01. The scoreboard image on the report's last page is headed 'Results for ICPC Asia Topi 2024 Onsite Preliminary' although the text calls it the top 12 of the contest.

sources.evidence: One-page letter whose subject line is the invitation to 'The 2024 ICPC Asia Topi Regional Contest' at GIK Institute, Topi, to be held 1-2 February 2025.
10-page 'Event Report' on the 2024 ICPC Asia Topi Regional Onsite Contest naming the champions and gold medallists, with an image of the top 12 teams and their medals.
11-page PDF headed 'The 2024 ICPC Asia Topi Regional Final On-site Contest' with instructions and Problems 01-09.

pakistan-2025.notes: The DOMjudge scoreboard lists 84 teams while the report counts 87 teams on site. The problem booklet's cover reads 'On-Site Preliminary Programming Contest', but its 12 problems match the onsite scoreboard's columns (1_FFT ... 12_TSTG).

sources.evidence: DOMjudge page 'ICPC Asia Topi 2025 Onsite' marked final standings, with 84 teams against 12 problems with times and tries.
15-page 'Event Report' of the 2025 ICPC Asia Topi Regional Onsite Contest with the gold-medal table and an image of the top 12 teams.
22-page booklet headed 'The 2025 ICPC Asia Topi On-Site Preliminary Programming Contest' with Problems 01-12, whose names match the scoreboard's problem codes.
